architecture: Minimal Overlay - reuse 90% of existing chat components with public-specific layout, plugin, and route protection

items.description: Add sessionStorage mode support to auth store (storageMode ref, setStorageMode action, update save/load/clear functions)
items.verification: grep -q 'storageMode' app/stores/auth.ts && grep -q 'setStorageMode' app/stores/auth.ts && grep -q 'sessionStorage' app/stores/auth.ts

items.description: Add publicAuthError state to config store (ref and setter action)
items.verification: grep -q 'publicAuthError' app/stores/config.ts && grep -q 'setPublicAuthError' app/stores/config.ts

items.description: Create usePublicMode composable with isPublicMode, publicAgentId, hasPublicAuthError computeds and helper functions
items.verification: test -f app/composables/usePublicMode.ts && grep -q 'isPublicMode' app/composables/usePublicMode.ts && grep -q 'isValidPublicAgent' app/composables/usePublicMode.ts

items.description: Create public.vue layout with loading spinner, error state, minimal full-height container, and Hungarian locale setting
items.verification: test -f app/layouts/public.vue && grep -q 'configStore.isLoaded' app/layouts/public.vue && grep -q 'h-dvh' app/layouts/public.vue

items.description: Create public-auth.client.ts plugin that auto-authenticates with config credentials in public mode
items.verification: test -f app/plugins/public-auth.client.ts && grep -q 'dependsOn.*config-init' app/plugins/public-auth.client.ts && grep -q 'publicLoginEmail' app/plugins/public-auth.client.ts

items.description: Modify auth.global.ts middleware to handle public mode routing (redirect non-public routes, block public routes in private mode, validate agentId)
items.verification: grep -q 'publicMode' app/middleware/auth.global.ts && grep -q '/chats/public/' app/middleware/auth.global.ts && grep -q 'publicAgent' app/middleware/auth.global.ts

items.description: Add disableSignalR prop to MessageInput.vue and guard all typing indicator logic with it
items.verification: grep -q 'disableSignalR' app/components/chat/MessageInput.vue && grep -q 'props.disableSignalR' app/components/chat/MessageInput.vue

items.description: Create /chats/public/new/[agentId].vue page with agent validation, session UUID generation, welcome message, and ChatMessages/MessageInput rendering
items.verification: test -f app/pages/chats/public/new/[agentId].vue && grep -q 'generateUUID' app/pages/chats/public/new/[agentId].vue && grep -q 'ChatMessages' app/pages/chats/public/new/[agentId].vue

items.description: Create /chats/public/[sessionId].vue page with session loading via useChatSession, messages display, and message input
items.verification: test -f app/pages/chats/public/[sessionId].vue && grep -q 'useChatSession' app/pages/chats/public/[sessionId].vue && grep -q 'ChatMessages' app/pages/chats/public/[sessionId].vue

items.description: Add navigation from new public chat to session page on first message sent (replace: true)
items.verification: grep -q 'replace.*true' app/pages/chats/public/new/[agentId].vue && grep -q '/chats/public/' app/pages/chats/public/new/[agentId].vue

items.description: Ensure send button is disabled while waiting for AI response (mutation.isPending check)
items.verification: grep -q 'isPending\|isLoading\|mutation' app/pages/chats/public/new/[agentId].vue || grep -q 'canSend' app/pages/chats/public/new/[agentId].vue

items.description: Hide voice recording button in public mode (either via prop or conditional in pages)
items.verification: grep -q 'isTranscriptionEnabled.*false\|:disable-voice\|v-if.*!isPublicMode' app/pages/chats/public/new/[agentId].vue || grep -q 'disableVoice' app/components/chat/MessageInput.vue

items.description: Test: Public mode auto-authentication works and stores token in sessionStorage
items.verification: manual: Set publicMode=1 in config, load app, verify redirect to /chats/public/new/[agent] and check sessionStorage for auth token

items.description: Test: Wrong agentId redirects to correct one from config
items.verification: manual: Navigate to /chats/public/new/999, verify redirect to /chats/public/new/[config.publicAgent]

items.description: Test: Private routes redirect to public chat in public mode
items.verification: manual: With publicMode=1, navigate to /chats or /login, verify redirect to public chat entry

items.description: Test: Public routes blocked in private mode (publicMode=0)
items.verification: manual: With publicMode=0, navigate to /chats/public/new/1, verify redirect to /login

items.description: Test: Full public chat flow - send message, navigate to session, continue conversation
items.verification: manual: In public mode, type message, send, verify navigation to session page, send another message, verify it appears

items.description: Test: Welcome message displays correctly in public chat
items.verification: manual: Load public chat, verify welcome message from agent appears at top of chat

items.description: Test: Session refresh creates fresh session (sessionStorage cleared)
items.verification: manual: In public chat with messages, refresh page, verify redirect to /chats/public/new/[agent] with empty chat

items.description: Test: No sidebar, no AppBar, no typing indicators visible in public mode
items.verification: manual: Load public chat, verify minimal UI - no sidebar toggle, no header bar, no typing dots when AI responds
